dhp90:1: For him who has completed his journey, for him who is free from sorrow,
dhp90:2: For him who has freed himself from the bonds which beset him on all sides,
dhp90:3: For him who has shaken off all the fetters, for such a one, no suffering is possible.
dhp91:1: They that are mindful, exert themselves, they take not pleasure in an abode;
dhp91:3: As geese leave a lake, so also do they leave house and home.
dhp92:1: They that possess not stores of food, they that know their food aright,
dhp92:3: They whose resort is the Void, the Uncaused, Deliverance,
dhp92:5: Their going is hard to follow, like the flight of birds through the air.
dhp93:1: He who has rid himself of the Contaminations, he who relies not upon food,
dhp93:3: He whose resort is the Void, the Uncaused, Deliverance,
dhp93:5: His going is hard to follow, like the flight of birds through the air.
dhp94:1: If a man’s senses have been brought to a state of tranquillity,
dhp94:2: Like horses well broken in by a charioteer,
dhp94:3: If he has put away pride, if he is free from the Contaminations,
dhp94:4: For such a man the gods cherish deep affection.
dhp95:1: Like the earth, he is not troubled; like a threshold, such is the virtuous;
dhp95:3: He is like a pool of water free from mud. The rounds of existence do not exist for such a man.
dhp96:1: His thoughts are calm, his speech is calm, his deeds are calm;
dhp96:3: Such is the calm of one who has obtained Deliverance by Right Knowledge.
dhp97:1: That man who is free from credulity, who knows the Uncreate, who has brought rebirth to an end,
dhp97:3: Who has put an end to every occasion of good and evil, who has renounced all desires, that man is the greatest of men.
dhp98:1: In a village it may be, or in a forest, on the sea, or on dry land;
dhp98:3: No matter where the Arahats reside, that spot is full of delight.
dhp99:1: Delightful are the woods; where the man of the world finds no delight,
dhp99:3: There they that are free from passion find delight, not they that seek after their lusts.
